title: 地下岩洞穹頂支護~Underground cavern crown support
focus: 岩洞穹頂的節理楔塊、岩拱與複合支護~Cavern-crown joint wedges, rock arching and composite support
summary: 大跨度岩洞的穩定同時受到節理幾何、開挖卸載、支護剛度及三維交叉口影響。本課分開討論可脫落楔塊與整體岩體拱效應，讓學徒用力學模型、應變監測及反算辨別真正的荷載路徑，再檢查地震與排水退化如何改變既有支護的需求。~Large-span cavern stability depends on joints, excavation unloading, support stiffness and three-dimensional intersections. This course distinguishes detachable wedges from rock-mass arching, uses force models, strain monitoring and back-analysis to identify load paths, and evaluates how seismic action and drainage deterioration change support demand.

units.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證~Joint wedge mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。楔塊是否形成取決於節理傾向、傾角及延續性，不能只從單一剖面推斷；重量則是滑移或掉落分析的基本荷載。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。~Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong. Formation depends on joint dip, direction and persistence and cannot be inferred from one section alone. Block weight is the basic load for a sliding or falling mechanism. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body.
units.model: 原創教學假設：岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³、假設楔塊體積V=12 m³，W=γV=312 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: With rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³ and assumed wedge volume V=12 m³, W=γV=312 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用掌子面與穹頂測繪建立三維節理面，對可能出露的塊體核對延續性與體積，不把所有交線當真實裂面。地質模型應保留節理可信度及未曝光區；開挖暴露新節理後，由地工設計者重核楔塊支護需求。~Build three-dimensional joint planes from face and crown mapping, verifying persistence and volume of potentially daylighting blocks rather than treating every intersection as a real release surface. Retain joint-confidence levels and unexposed areas in the geological model; the geotechnical designer reassesses wedge support when new joints are exposed.
units.failure: 節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。~Underestimated persistence can miss a large wedge; local falls may precede geometric instability and must not be dismissed using an average rock-mass rating. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body.
units.misconception: 完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。~High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls.
units.practice: 地質模型應保留節理可信度及未曝光區；開挖暴露新節理後，由地工設計者重核楔塊支護需求。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。~Retain joint-confidence levels and unexposed areas in the geological model; the geotechnical designer reassesses wedge support when new joints are exposed. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body.

units.title: 岩拱應力的機理與驗證~Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 地下開挖把原先穿越洞室的應力重新分配到穹頂與側牆，岩體可形成拱狀傳力，但拱腳必須有足夠拘束。上覆地層重量提供初始應力量級，實際水平應力及構造作用則可能主導局部壓碎、剝落或高側牆變形。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。~Excavation redirects stresses that previously crossed the cavern into the crown and sidewalls, allowing arch-like transfer only if the abutments retain confinement. Overburden weight gives an initial stress scale, while horizontal and tectonic stresses may govern local crushing, spalling or tall-wall deformation. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設均質覆岩γ=26 kN/m³、深度H=100 m，垂直應力σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For homogeneous overburden γ=26 kN/m³ and depth H=100 m, vertical stress σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 對照覆岩地形與原位應力量測，追蹤穹頂及側牆收斂方向，檢查數值模型的拱腳反力位置。分層開挖方案須同時檢查穹頂及拱腳，不可只更新拱頂斷面；側牆開挖停留點由岩洞設計者確認。~Compare overburden topography and in-situ stress measurements, track crown and sidewall convergence directions, and inspect arch-abutment reactions in the numerical model. Stage analysis must update both crown and abutments, not only the roof section; the cavern designer confirms hold points for sidewall excavation.
units.failure: 側牆卸載破壞拱腳拘束時，穹頂支護需求會增加；單看拱頂位移小可能漏掉側向失穩。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。~Sidewall unloading can weaken arch confinement and increase crown-support demand; small crown movement alone may conceal a developing lateral instability. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment.
units.misconception: 上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。~All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell.
units.practice: 分層開挖方案須同時檢查穹頂及拱腳，不可只更新拱頂斷面；側牆開挖停留點由岩洞設計者確認。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。~Stage analysis must update both crown and abutments, not only the roof section; the cavern designer confirms hold points for sidewall excavation. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment.

units.title: 跨度效應的機理與驗證~Span effect mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 增加岩洞跨度會增加支護跨越弱區的需求，也改變節理楔塊可形成的尺寸。均布荷載簡支梁的平方尺度可提醒跨度敏感度，但岩洞不是自由梁，實際承載由岩體、噴凝土及錨索共同提供，不能把梁式直接當岩洞設計公式。這個比值只對假設的梁系統成立，並非任何實際岩洞的承載力比例；尺寸放大還可能改變節理機制與施工方法。~Greater cavern span increases the distance support must bridge across weak ground and changes possible wedge dimensions. The squared-span scaling of a uniformly loaded simple beam illustrates sensitivity, but a cavern is not a free beam: rock, shotcrete and anchors share resistance, so the beam relation is not a cavern design equation. The ratio applies only to the assumed beam system, not the resistance of an actual cavern; scaling geometry can also change joint mechanisms and construction methods.
units.model: 原創教學假設：僅作等載重簡支梁比較，L₁=18 m、L₂=24 m，M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Only for equal-load simple-beam comparison, L₁=18 m and L₂=24 m give M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 比較各跨度方案的地質暴露、楔塊幾何與支護位移，使用同一材料及邊界條件檢查敏感度。方案比較應把模型形式與不變參數列清楚；結構及地工設計者共同確認何時必須改採三維岩體分析。~Compare geological exposure, wedge geometry and support displacement across span alternatives, keeping material and boundary assumptions consistent in the sensitivity study. State model form and fixed parameters in option comparisons; structural and geotechnical designers jointly decide when three-dimensional rock analysis becomes necessary.
units.failure: 把較小岩洞的支護間距原封不動放大使用，可能造成未支承塊體尺寸增加與局部超載。這個比值只對假設的梁系統成立，並非任何實際岩洞的承載力比例；尺寸放大還可能改變節理機制與施工方法。~Reusing small-cavern support spacing unchanged for a larger cavern may increase unsupported block size and local demand. The ratio applies only to the assumed beam system, not the resistance of an actual cavern; scaling geometry can also change joint mechanisms and construction methods.
units.misconception: 洞室跨度變大時，只按跨度比例增加支護即可。~Support only needs to increase linearly with cavern span.
units.practice: 方案比較應把模型形式與不變參數列清楚；結構及地工設計者共同確認何時必須改採三維岩體分析。這個比值只對假設的梁系統成立，並非任何實際岩洞的承載力比例；尺寸放大還可能改變節理機制與施工方法。~State model form and fixed parameters in option comparisons; structural and geotechnical designers jointly decide when three-dimensional rock analysis becomes necessary. The ratio applies only to the assumed beam system, not the resistance of an actual cavern; scaling geometry can also change joint mechanisms and construction methods.

units.title: 錨索分力的機理與驗證~Cable support component mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 穹頂錨索須跨越可能移動的岩塊並錨入穩定岩體，才能提供有效拘束。錨力沿索軸傳遞，只有對抗位移方向的分量直接抗衡掉落；錨索角度也可能增加節理法向力而改變摩擦，但需要在自由體圖中明確計入。分力總和未檢查群體作用、鋼材容量或長期損失，也不代表每支錨索均勻受力；應另核對變形相容與試驗證據。~Crown cables must cross the moving block and bond into stable rock to provide restraint. Force acts along the cable, and only its component opposing motion directly resists falling. Cable inclination may also increase joint normal force and friction, but that contribution must be represented explicitly in the free-body model. The component sum omits group effects, steel resistance and long-term losses and does not prove equal cable loading; check deformation compatibility and test evidence separately.
units.model: 原創教學假設：4支錨索各T=150 kN、與抗落方向夾角θ=30°，有效分力R=4Tcosθ=520 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For four cables each carrying T=150 kN at θ=30° to the resisting direction, R=4Tcosθ=520 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對鑽孔方向、錨碇段位置及張力紀錄，以載重試驗檢查錨固行為，再把實際角度帶入力平衡。竣工圖要標出自由段、錨碇段與節理面的相對位置；地工設計者確認錨定區穩定後才放行支護驗收。~Verify bore direction, bond-zone position and force records, use load tests to assess anchorage, and insert actual angles into equilibrium. As-built drawings show free and bond lengths relative to joints; the geotechnical designer confirms stable anchorage before support acceptance.
units.failure: 錨碇段仍位於可動楔塊內時，張拉成功不代表已把力傳入穩定岩體，可能整組一同移動。分力總和未檢查群體作用、鋼材容量或長期損失，也不代表每支錨索均勻受力；應另核對變形相容與試驗證據。~A bond zone inside the moving wedge may tension successfully without transferring force into stable ground, allowing the whole assembly to move together. The component sum omits group effects, steel resistance and long-term losses and does not prove equal cable loading; check deformation compatibility and test evidence separately.
units.misconception: 錨索總張力直接相加就是任意方向的支護力。~Adding cable tensions directly gives support resistance in every direction.
units.practice: 竣工圖要標出自由段、錨碇段與節理面的相對位置；地工設計者確認錨定區穩定後才放行支護驗收。分力總和未檢查群體作用、鋼材容量或長期損失，也不代表每支錨索均勻受力；應另核對變形相容與試驗證據。~As-built drawings show free and bond lengths relative to joints; the geotechnical designer confirms stable anchorage before support acceptance. The component sum omits group effects, steel resistance and long-term losses and does not prove equal cable loading; check deformation compatibility and test evidence separately.

units.title: 噴凝土面板的機理與驗證~Shotcrete panel mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 噴凝土可束制小塊岩石並與錨桿形成局部面板系統，厚度、纖維殘餘強度及與岩面黏結共同影響其性能。面板平均壓力只能描述總荷載除以面積，不能說明孔邊沖切、薄弱處彎曲或早齡期承載是否足夠。均布壓力並不代表真正局部荷載形狀，面板需依支點與岩塊接觸重新分析；本式不能取代噴凝土構件驗算。~Shotcrete restrains small blocks and forms local panels with rock bolts; thickness, fibre residual strength and rock adhesion jointly govern performance. Average panel pressure is only total load divided by area and does not establish resistance to punching near bolts, bending at thin spots or loading at early age. Uniform pressure does not establish the actual contact pattern; panels require analysis with their supports and block contacts, and this expression cannot replace member checks.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設局部岩塊荷重W=20 kN、分配面板面積A=4 m²，平均q=W/A=5 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For local block load W=20 kN distributed over panel area A=4 m², mean q=W/A=5 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用厚度針、取芯及面板試驗核對厚度與韌性，檢查錨頭附近薄弱區；將材料齡期與實際加載時間配對。檢驗計畫應把厚度、黏結及殘餘強度分列；未達指定齡期與試驗要求前，由支護設計者確認後續開挖限制。~Check thickness and toughness using depth pins, cores and panel tests, inspect thin zones near bolt heads, and match material age to actual loading time. The inspection plan separates thickness, bond and residual-strength evidence; the support designer confirms excavation restrictions until specified age and test requirements are satisfied.
units.failure: 表面平整但局部過薄或背後脫黏，會使面板突然剝落；只驗抗壓強度可能漏掉韌性不足。均布壓力並不代表真正局部荷載形狀，面板需依支點與岩塊接觸重新分析；本式不能取代噴凝土構件驗算。~A smooth surface can conceal thin spots or debonding that cause panel detachment; compressive strength alone may miss inadequate toughness. Uniform pressure does not establish the actual contact pattern; panels require analysis with their supports and block contacts, and this expression cannot replace member checks.
units.misconception: 噴凝土表面看起來連續就具有均勻厚度與韌性。~A continuous-looking shotcrete surface has uniform thickness and toughness.
units.practice: 檢驗計畫應把厚度、黏結及殘餘強度分列；未達指定齡期與試驗要求前，由支護設計者確認後續開挖限制。均布壓力並不代表真正局部荷載形狀，面板需依支點與岩塊接觸重新分析；本式不能取代噴凝土構件驗算。~The inspection plan separates thickness, bond and residual-strength evidence; the support designer confirms excavation restrictions until specified age and test requirements are satisfied. Uniform pressure does not establish the actual contact pattern; panels require analysis with their supports and block contacts, and this expression cannot replace member checks.

units.title: 應變換算的機理與驗證~Strain conversion mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 噴凝土或鋼構件的應變可反映支護開始參與承載的時間，但量測值包含溫度、收縮與儀器零點變化。用彈性模數換算應力前須先分離機械應變；早齡期模數及潛變不確定時，單一讀值無法唯一推回實際作用力。線彈性式只適用於所取機械增量與相應模數，不能跨越開裂或大幅潛變狀態；零讀值也不代表構件沒有歷史荷載。~Support strain can indicate when shotcrete or steel begins carrying load, but readings include temperature, shrinkage and zero drift. Separate mechanical strain before multiplying by modulus; uncertain early-age stiffness and creep mean one reading cannot uniquely recover the actual force carried by the support. The elastic expression applies to the selected mechanical increment and corresponding modulus, not across cracking or major creep; a zero reading does not imply absence of historical load.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設已扣除溫度與收縮、E=20 GPa、機械應變ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶，Δσ=Eε=1 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: After temperature and shrinkage correction, assume E=20 GPa and mechanical ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶; Δσ=Eε=1 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 成對配置應變與溫度感測器，保存安裝、歸零及開挖時間；用材料試驗模數檢查換算範圍。原始讀值與修正值須分開保存；感測器更換或歸零由監測負責人記錄，設計者審核其對基準連續性的影響。~Pair strain and temperature sensors, retain installation, zeroing and excavation times, and use tested moduli to bound stress conversion. Preserve raw and corrected readings separately; the monitoring lead records sensor replacement or rezeroing, and the designer reviews its effect on baseline continuity.
units.failure: 把冷卻收縮全部當成荷載應變，會誤判支護超載；錯誤歸零也可能抹掉施工前已存在的應變。線彈性式只適用於所取機械增量與相應模數，不能跨越開裂或大幅潛變狀態；零讀值也不代表構件沒有歷史荷載。~Treating cooling contraction entirely as load strain can falsely indicate overload, while incorrect zeroing can erase strain that existed before later excavation. The elastic expression applies to the selected mechanical increment and corresponding modulus, not across cracking or major creep; a zero reading does not imply absence of historical load.
units.misconception: 量到應變後乘上固定模數即可得到精確永久應力。~Measured strain times one constant modulus gives exact permanent stress.
units.practice: 原始讀值與修正值須分開保存；感測器更換或歸零由監測負責人記錄，設計者審核其對基準連續性的影響。線彈性式只適用於所取機械增量與相應模數，不能跨越開裂或大幅潛變狀態；零讀值也不代表構件沒有歷史荷載。~Preserve raw and corrected readings separately; the monitoring lead records sensor replacement or rezeroing, and the designer reviews its effect on baseline continuity. The elastic expression applies to the selected mechanical increment and corresponding modulus, not across cracking or major creep; a zero reading does not imply absence of historical load.

units.anchor: 交叉口開口率~Intersection opening ratio
units.title: 交叉口開口率的機理與驗證~Intersection opening ratio mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 支洞穿入大岩洞會切斷局部岩拱及支護連續性，使受力呈三維繞流。開口面積比例可用於列出幾何擾動程度，但開口位置比單一比例更重要；靠近拱腳或大型節理交會處的小開口，也可能導致顯著的應力轉移。開口率是無因次幾何指標，沒有直接的強度允收值；必須另查形狀、距離、支護連續性及交會角度。~A branch cavern interrupts local rock arching and support continuity, forcing three-dimensional load redistribution. Opening-area ratio is useful for describing geometric disturbance, but location can matter more than the ratio: a small opening near an abutment or major joint intersection may cause substantial stress transfer. Opening ratio is a dimensionless geometry descriptor without a direct strength acceptance limit; shape, spacing, support continuity and intersection angle require independent checks.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設交叉開口Aopen=12 m²、參考牆面Aref=60 m²，幾何開口率r=Aopen/Aref=0.20。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For opening area Aopen=12 m² and reference wall area Aref=60 m², geometric opening ratio r=Aopen/Aref=0.20. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 建立三維開口及節理模型，量測角隅收斂與支護應變；將分部開挖順序與反應峰值對時比較。交叉口應有獨立地質與支護剖面；設計者確認三維荷載轉移及分部開挖停留點後，才可套用洞身標準細部。~Model openings and joints in three dimensions, measure corner convergence and support strain, and align response peaks with staged excavation. Provide dedicated geological and support sections at intersections; the designer verifies three-dimensional transfer and excavation hold points before standard tunnel details are adopted.
units.failure: 把交叉口當成二維直線洞身會漏掉角隅應力與拱腳削弱，裂縫可能集中在支洞交會處。開口率是無因次幾何指標，沒有直接的強度允收值；必須另查形狀、距離、支護連續性及交會角度。~Treating an intersection as a two-dimensional uniform tunnel misses corner stresses and weakened abutments, allowing damage to concentrate at the branch junction. Opening ratio is a dimensionless geometry descriptor without a direct strength acceptance limit; shape, spacing, support continuity and intersection angle require independent checks.
units.misconception: 開口率相同的兩個交叉口一定具有相同穩定性。~Two intersections with the same opening ratio have the same stability.
units.practice: 交叉口應有獨立地質與支護剖面；設計者確認三維荷載轉移及分部開挖停留點後，才可套用洞身標準細部。開口率是無因次幾何指標，沒有直接的強度允收值；必須另查形狀、距離、支護連續性及交會角度。~Provide dedicated geological and support sections at intersections; the designer verifies three-dimensional transfer and excavation hold points before standard tunnel details are adopted. Opening ratio is a dimensionless geometry descriptor without a direct strength acceptance limit; shape, spacing, support continuity and intersection angle require independent checks.

units.title: 反算剛度的機理與驗證~Back-calculated stiffness mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 已知荷載與位移可反算等效剛度，用於檢查分析模型是否過軟或過硬，但不同的岩體參數、接縫滑移與支護剛度可能產生相似位移。只配合一個量測點會造成參數不可識別，必須用多位置與多階段反應限制合理解的範圍。此剛度屬特定階段與荷載路徑的等效值，不是岩石材料模數；若量測含剛體移動，須先移除其影響。~Known force and displacement can provide an equivalent stiffness for checking whether an analysis is too soft or stiff. Different rock parameters, joint slip and support stiffness can produce similar displacement, however. Fitting one point creates an identifiability problem; several locations and construction stages are needed to constrain plausible solutions. This is an equivalent stiffness for one stage and load path, not a rock material modulus; rigid-body movement must be separated before interpreting the measurement.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設對應荷載增量ΔF=500 kN、位移增量Δu=5 mm，等效k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For corresponding increments ΔF=500 kN and Δu=5 mm, equivalent stiffness k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以多支伸長計、收斂點及支護力共同反算，保留未用於配適的資料作驗證，檢查參數是否仍具物理意義。反算報告應列參數相關性、測值誤差及獨立驗證結果；變更支護前，由設計者審核而非以自動最佳配適放行。~Back-analyse extensometers, convergence and support forces together, retaining unused observations for validation and checking that fitted parameters remain physically meaningful. Report parameter correlations, measurement error and independent validation; the designer reviews them before support changes rather than accepting an automatic best fit.
units.failure: 任意調整岩體模數直到位移吻合，可能掩蓋錯誤支承邊界，導致下一開挖階段預測失準。此剛度屬特定階段與荷載路徑的等效值，不是岩石材料模數；若量測含剛體移動，須先移除其影響。~Adjusting rock modulus until displacement matches can conceal incorrect support boundaries and produce poor predictions for the next excavation stage. This is an equivalent stiffness for one stage and load path, not a rock material modulus; rigid-body movement must be separated before interpreting the measurement.
units.misconception: 模型配合一個監測點就證明所有地層參數正確。~Matching one monitoring point proves every ground parameter is correct.
units.practice: 反算報告應列參數相關性、測值誤差及獨立驗證結果；變更支護前，由設計者審核而非以自動最佳配適放行。此剛度屬特定階段與荷載路徑的等效值，不是岩石材料模數；若量測含剛體移動，須先移除其影響。~Report parameter correlations, measurement error and independent validation; the designer reviews them before support changes rather than accepting an automatic best fit. This is an equivalent stiffness for one stage and load path, not a rock material modulus; rigid-body movement must be separated before interpreting the measurement.

units.title: 地震慣性的機理與驗證~Seismic inertia mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 地震可對穹頂楔塊施加附加慣性力，也會改變節理接觸與支護受力方向。擬靜力係數提供簡化水平力，但忽略波傳、相位及結構變形差異；地下工程不能只因埋置而假設沒有地震需求，尤其需要查節理與錨固區的相對變位。擬靜力係數不是任意選用的通用常數，且此單一水平力不包含垂直作用或波傳應變；應按專案地震分析基準選擇。~Earthquakes add inertia to crown wedges and alter joint contact and support-force direction. A pseudo-static coefficient supplies a simplified horizontal force but omits wave propagation, phase and differential deformation. Burial alone does not eliminate seismic demand, particularly where joints and anchorage zones undergo relative movement. The pseudo-static coefficient is not a universal arbitrary constant, and this horizontal force excludes vertical action and wave strain; select it under the project's seismic-analysis basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設楔塊重量W=312 kN、水平擬靜力係數kh=0.15，Fh=khW=46.8 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For wedge weight W=312 kN and horizontal pseudo-static coefficient kh=0.15, Fh=khW=46.8 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對場址地震需求與楔塊可動方向，分別檢查不同加速度方向的自由體圖，必要時以動力分析驗證。交接計畫應列地震後需檢查的節理、錨頭與噴凝土區域；地工設計者確認受損機制後才核准重新開放。~Check site seismic demand and admissible wedge movement, evaluate free bodies for different acceleration directions, and verify with dynamic analysis when required. Handover identifies joints, anchor heads and shotcrete zones for post-earthquake inspection; the geotechnical designer confirms damage mechanisms before reopening is approved.
units.failure: 地震使節理張開或錨索失去有效錨碇時，原有靜態安全餘裕可能消失，事件後局部落塊須重新調查。擬靜力係數不是任意選用的通用常數，且此單一水平力不包含垂直作用或波傳應變；應按專案地震分析基準選擇。~Seismic joint opening or loss of effective anchorage can consume static margins; post-event local falls require renewed investigation of the support system. The pseudo-static coefficient is not a universal arbitrary constant, and this horizontal force excludes vertical action and wave strain; select it under the project's seismic-analysis basis.
units.misconception: 地下岩洞不受地表搖動，所以支護不用耐震檢查。~Underground caverns do not experience surface shaking, so support needs no seismic checks.
units.practice: 交接計畫應列地震後需檢查的節理、錨頭與噴凝土區域；地工設計者確認受損機制後才核准重新開放。擬靜力係數不是任意選用的通用常數，且此單一水平力不包含垂直作用或波傳應變；應按專案地震分析基準選擇。~Handover identifies joints, anchor heads and shotcrete zones for post-earthquake inspection; the geotechnical designer confirms damage mechanisms before reopening is approved. The pseudo-static coefficient is not a universal arbitrary constant, and this horizontal force excludes vertical action and wave strain; select it under the project's seismic-analysis basis.

units.anchor: 排水與接觸力~Drainage and contact force
units.title: 排水與接觸力的機理與驗證~Drainage and contact force mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 岩洞節理中的水壓會減少有效法向接觸，降低摩擦可動員程度；排水系統因此是支護性能的一部分。時間久後的沉積或結垢可使局部水壓恢復，外觀乾燥並不能證明深部節理無壓，維護應把水頭變化與支護反應一起追蹤。本式假設均勻水壓與有效接觸面積，部分張開節理需重新界定面積；若計算負值，不能把摩擦抗力當成負值繼續套用。~Water pressure in joints reduces effective normal contact and available friction, making drainage part of support performance. Sediment or mineral buildup can restore local water pressure with time. A dry visible surface does not establish unpressurized deeper joints, so maintenance must track hydraulic head together with support response. The expression assumes uniform pressure and a defined contact area; partly open joints require revised area, and a negative result cannot be carried forward as negative friction resistance.
units.model: 原創教學假設：法向總力N=500 kN、均勻節理水壓u=100 kPa、面積A=2 m²，N′=N−uA=300 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: With total normal force N=500 kN, uniform joint pressure u=100 kPa and area A=2 m², N′=N−uA=300 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 將排水流量、水壓計與節理開合量對時比對，檢查低流量是否代表缺水或堵塞，保留清理前後資料。維護資料須記各排水孔的集水區與通達性；清理或封孔前，由地工及營運負責人核定對接觸力的影響。~Compare drain flow, piezometers and joint opening on one clock, distinguishing low inflow from blockage and retaining evidence before and after cleaning. Maintenance records identify each drain's catchment and access; geotechnical and operations leads approve the effect on contact force before cleaning or sealing drains.
units.failure: 排水堵塞可能使摩擦力下降而表面流量變小；若誤以為滲水改善，會錯過接觸力衰減的訊號。本式假設均勻水壓與有效接觸面積，部分張開節理需重新界定面積；若計算負值，不能把摩擦抗力當成負值繼續套用。~Blocked drainage may reduce friction while visible flow decreases; interpreting reduced seepage as improvement can miss the loss of effective contact force. The expression assumes uniform pressure and a defined contact area; partly open joints require revised area, and a negative result cannot be carried forward as negative friction resistance.
units.misconception: 排水量減少一定表示岩洞變得更乾燥且更穩定。~Lower drain flow always means a drier and more stable cavern.
units.practice: 維護資料須記各排水孔的集水區與通達性；清理或封孔前，由地工及營運負責人核定對接觸力的影響。本式假設均勻水壓與有效接觸面積，部分張開節理需重新界定面積；若計算負值，不能把摩擦抗力當成負值繼續套用。~Maintenance records identify each drain's catchment and access; geotechnical and operations leads approve the effect on contact force before cleaning or sealing drains. The expression assumes uniform pressure and a defined contact area; partly open joints require revised area, and a negative result cannot be carried forward as negative friction resistance.

example: 原創教學例：假設穹頂可動楔塊體積V=12 m³，岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=312 kN。若地質測繪使估計體積增加10%至13.2 m³，重量增為343.2 kN，增加31.2 kN。這個結果只修改重力項，不表示所需錨力也一定按相同比例增加，因為楔塊形狀改變可能同時影響節理接觸面、出露方向與錨索穿越位置。必須重新建立三維自由體圖，檢查水壓、摩擦及錨固，再用獨立地質觀測確認模型。~Original teaching example: assume a potentially movable crown wedge of V=12 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Its weight is W=γV=312 kN. If mapping increases the estimated volume by 10% to 13.2 m³, weight becomes 343.2 kN, an increase of 31.2 kN. This changes gravity only; required cable force need not increase by the same percentage because revised geometry may also change joint contact area, daylighting direction and cable intersections. Rebuild the three-dimensional free body, check water pressure, friction and anchorage, and corroborate the geometry with independent geological observations.
history: 大跨度岩洞的穩定同時受到節理幾何、開挖卸載、支護剛度及三維交叉口影響。本課分開討論可脫落楔塊與整體岩體拱效應，讓學徒用力學模型、應變監測及反算辨別真正的荷載路徑，再檢查地震與排水退化如何改變既有支護的需求。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1997年：美國陸軍工兵署發布岩石隧道與豎井工程手冊，建立公開工程參考；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2018年：香港發布岩洞工程指南第二版，整理岩洞規劃設計及施工實務。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Large-span cavern stability depends on joints, excavation unloading, support stiffness and three-dimensional intersections. This course distinguishes detachable wedges from rock-mass arching, uses force models, strain monitoring and back-analysis to identify load paths, and evaluates how seismic action and drainage deterioration change support demand. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1997: USACE publishes its rock-tunnel and shaft manual as a public engineering reference; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2018: CEDD publishes the second cavern-engineering guide covering planning, design and construction. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

合成教學假設：僅作等載重簡支梁比較，L₁=18 m、L₂=24 m，M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78~Synthetic teaching assumptions: Only for equal-load simple-beam comparison, L₁=18 m and L₂=24 m give M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78
合成教學假設：4支錨索各T=150 kN、與抗落方向夾角θ=30°，有效分力R=4Tcosθ=520 kN~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For four cables each carrying T=150 kN at θ=30° to the resisting direction, R=4Tcosθ=520 kN
合成教學假設：假設局部岩塊荷重W=20 kN、分配面板面積A=4 m²，平均q=W/A=5 kPa~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For local block load W=20 kN distributed over panel area A=4 m², mean q=W/A=5 kPa
合成教學假設：假設已扣除溫度與收縮、E=20 GPa、機械應變ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶，Δσ=Eε=1 MPa~Synthetic teaching assumptions: After temperature and shrinkage correction, assume E=20 GPa and mechanical ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶
